title: 6.6 The bakery is on the corner
unit_outcome: Ask whether a place is near, say how people go to work and why they go somewhere, find a platform or gate, pack for a trip, find places on a street, follow and ask for directions, ask permission, buy tickets, understand delays and check in at a hotel.
lesson_title: The bakery is on the corner
sub_lesson_title: The bakery is on the corner
goal: Say where a place is with on the corner and opposite (The bakery is on the corner. The police station is opposite the park.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 6.6 Finding Places in the Neighborhood: A1 locates places with near, far from, between and across from; A1+ 6.6 adds on the corner and opposite. Each photo shows one place from 6.1 either in a corner building where two streets meet, with a crosswalk on each side, or across one street from a small park, seen from the park, so the photo tells on the corner from opposite the park.
prerequisite: A1 6.6 across from; A1+ 6.1 bakery, bookstore, police station, gas station; A1+ 4.1 Where's…?.
speaking_outcome: Stress the CORN-er and OP-po-site. Do not require native-like speed.
